offer.name: KnownFix
offer.description: Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

perFix.display: $0.05 USDC on Base, or signed exact ETH
perFix.note: USDC is dollar-denominated; the ETH equivalent drifts.

backend.note: Durably hosted on Deno Deploy (KV-backed double-spend guard). Stable, always-on, no rotation. The backend serves its own /.well-known/farebox.json and a remote MCP server at /mcp.

settlement.offerRoute: POST {backend}/offer with productType, productId, and currency
settlement.offerTool: get_offer with productType, productId, and currency
settlement.route: use the signed Base Pay or exact-ETH parameters; redeem with both proof headers
rules: only purchase when backend.status is live-durable/live-ephemeral, backend.url is non-null, and backend.acceptingPayments is true
the signed bearer offer is private, product- and currency-bound, and expires after one hour
USDC redemption verifies the Base Pay UserOperation, operation-scoped canonical Transfer, and private calldata suffix; ETH verifies the exact transaction value
a payment proof and offer can each be redeemed once, atomically
